item.title: Beyond Meat drops the ‘Meat’ from its name as it expands to plant-based drinks and snacks
item.description: Beyond Meat is dropping “meat” from its name as it moves beyond the struggling market for plant-based burgers, sausages and tenders and expands into new categories like protein drinks. The company now known as the Beyond The Plant Protein Co., or simply Beyond on its packaging, changed its website and social media channels this week.
